description: This file defines the ProjectAdminUserRole class, a specific user role in the OrangeHRM system managing access to projects, customers, and employees based on permissions. It extends the AbstractUserRole and utilizes traits for project and customer services.

classes.name: ProjectAdminUserRole
classes.description: A user role class for project administrators with methods to retrieve accessible entity IDs based on permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns IDs of entities (Employee, Project, Customer) accessible to this user based on permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIds
methods.description: Fetches employee IDs accessible for the project admin, conditioned on specific permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleProjectIds
methods.description: Retrieves project IDs accessible to the user as a project admin.

methods.name: getAccessibleCustomerIds
methods.description: Retrieves customer IDs accessible to the user as a project admin.
